name: sys
description: A SYS band above the prompt: CPU load, RAM in use and battery, each with a 6-cell bar and traffic-light colours, read every 5 seconds; a btop button that opens btop in a herdr pane below, and /sys.

band.title: SYS band above the prompt
band.description: on: the SYS row, read every 5 seconds while a terminal shows it; off: no row and no reading (/sys now and btop still work). /sys on|off overrides this.
